title: Valentín's Homemade French Toast
description: A classic French toast with a cinnamon-vanilla custard, golden and crisp on the outside and soft in the middle.

ingredients.note: day-old brioche, challah, or white bread works best

steps: In a shallow dish, whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt until smooth.
Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat and melt a little butter.
Dip a slice of bread in the egg mixture for about 10 seconds per side, until soaked but not falling apart.
Cook in the hot pan for 2–3 minutes per side, until golden brown. Add more butter to the pan between batches.
Keep finished slices warm on a tray in a 200°F (95°C) oven while you cook the rest.
Serve warm with maple syrup and any toppings you like.
